units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:20">Ab. IV, 20</cite> <he>יש … מ׳ ישן</he> many a new vessel is full of old wine (many a young man is full of wisdom).
Meg. 6ᵃ (ref. to Ez. XXVI, 2) אם מ׳ זו חרבה זו when one (of the two cities, Jerusalem and Caesarea) is full, the other is waste; a. fr.—Esp. a full month, of thirty days.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 58a:6">Bekh. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>זימנין מ׳ וכ׳</he> at times (in some years) it is full, at times defective, v. <cite ref="H01413"><he>חָסֵר</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מְלֵאִים</he>, <he>מְלֵאִין</he>, <cite ref="M01543"><he>מְלֵי׳</he></cite>; f. <he>מְלֵאוֹת</he>, <cite ref="M01543"><he>מְלֵי׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 57a:3">Ber. 57ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 19a:23">Erub. 19ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>מ׳ מצות כרמון</he> are full of good deeds as a pomegranate (is full of seeds); a. fr.—[<cite ref="M01465"><he>מְלֵאָה</he></cite> as a noun, v. <cite ref="M01547"><he>מְלֵיאָה</he></cite>.]
